## v0.5.23: Faster memory operations / 记忆操作性能优化

Publishes [#330](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/330): linear Runtime compaction, fewer Document excerpts, indexed space discovery and pinned-space resolution, single-pass recall statistics, cheaper batch preparation and stable bounded Holographic ranking. Result order, permissions, storage formats and UI flows are preserved.

发布 [#330](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/330)：Runtime 线性压缩、按返回结果生成 Document 摘要、空间发现与固定空间解析索引、单次遍历的召回统计、更低成本的批量准备，以及 Holographic 稳定有界排名。结果顺序、权限、存储格式与 UI 流程保持不变。

The Starter advances to **0.5.23**, Runtime to **0.5.12**, Documents to **0.5.9**, Memory Spaces to **0.5.15** and Holographic to **0.5.6**. The other 13 component versions are unchanged.

Starter 升至 **0.5.23**，Runtime 升至 **0.5.12**，Documents 升至 **0.5.9**，Memory Spaces 升至 **0.5.15**，Holographic 升至 **0.5.6**；其余 13 个组件版本不变。

Measured N=1/10/100/1000 workloads are documented in the audit. At N=1000, local Runtime compaction falls from 41.347 ms to 4.047 ms, and local multi-space recall orchestration from 254.008 ms to 9.834 ms. These synthetic measurements exclude remote Provider and LLM latency.

审计记录 N=1/10/100/1000 的测试。在 N=1000 时，本地 Runtime 压缩从 41.347 ms 降至 4.047 ms，多路召回本地编排从 254.008 ms 降至 9.834 ms；合成测试不包含远程 Provider 和 LLM 延迟。

From v0.5.22, use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH. Or install the exact version:

从 v0.5.22 可使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH；也可安装精确版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.23
```

No memory migration is required. 无需迁移已有记忆。
